tools.name: search_tarot_cards
tools.description: Search the 78-card Rider–Waite–Smith deck by name and return matching cards with the slugs the other tools take. Use this first when you only have a card name.

tools.name: get_tarot_card_love_meaning
tools.description: What one tarot card means for love and relationships: upright, reversed, as someone’s feelings, in the context of an ex, plus its yes/no leaning and element. Returns markdown.

tools.name: get_love_question_answer
tools.description: The long-form answer to one of the most-asked love-tarot questions ("will he come back", "does he miss me", …) and which cards speak to it. Call with no slug to list the available questions. Returns markdown.
